reviews.review_description: Slice the Rhythm is simply fun to play. It has great music and a rewarding rhythm based combat system that quickly turns into a great workout. The gameplay is super easy to pick up and focuses on chaining together punches and slashes while staying on the beat, making every combo feel satisfying. Adding your own music is also incredibly simple, you just drop your tracks into a folder, and the game automatically finds them. It's awesome being able to play through my favorite slow jams and '80s tracks. Playing a game to the Linger from the cranberry's was ridiculous. The visuals are really cool as well. As you slice through enemies, their colored blood stains your blades, and splatter shows up on the ground as the song progresses. My favorite part is that the game doesn't punish you for missing targets or enemies. Instead, you can keep playing and focus on building bigger combos, which makes the experience much more fun and relaxed than many other rhythm games. It is one of my favorite easy to jump into rhythm games and well worth checking out.

developer_response.body:
I'm really glad you enjoyed the game!
From the very beginning, our goal was to create a rhythm game that doesn't punish players for every mistake or interrupt the gameplay when they miss a beat. Instead, we wanted to give everyone the freedom to fight at their own sense of rhythm and simply enjoy the experience.
We're very happy to hear that this core design philosophy comes through and makes the game satisfying for both newcomers and experienced players alike.
Good luck beating your high scores! 😊

reviews.review_description:
It’s a nice looking game, graphics look cool,  the mechanics work well.
Feels good to keep a zombie up in the air for 10 or more hits.
Slicing is nice to do, you need a lot of room, as they come at you from all directions and it’s frenetic and fast  once you get going.
A nice addition to this type of genre.

Slice the rhythm delivers a satisfying mix of rhythm and combat. The gameplay is easy to learn, but chasing higher scores and longer combos keeps it engaging over time.

The combat feels responsive, the music synchronization works well, and the custom song support adds extra replay value. The core gameplay loop is enjoyable and offers a fun arcade-style VR experience.

The music and swordplay work so well together, and it feels really satisfying once you get into the rhythm. The controls are smooth, the gameplay is fun, and it's easy to pick up after the tutorial. The music is excellent, and the visuals are clear, vibrant, and polished.

You'll definitely need eyes in the back of your head—this is true 360° immersion, with enemies coming at you from every direction. I wouldn't recommend playing it seated, as standing gives you the freedom to swing and slash all around you. If you enjoy fast-paced rhythm games, this is definitely worth checking out. As a bonus, you'll get a great workout while playing!

developer_response.body:
Hi!

Thank you so much for another fantastic review! 😊 We really appreciate you taking the time to share your thoughts.
We're very happy that you enjoyed the game, and we're already planning more updates to make it even better.
Good luck in your future runs, and thanks again for your support!

reviews.review_description: I already enjoyed same style of action rhythm app. I thought it would be similar, but this is differently difficult. I have to constantly punch and thrash enemies coming from all sides to the rhythm as required. I have to deal with it with great agility and shrewdness, but it's too much for me. I wish there was an option to adjust the difficulty. Merci Lionel!

developer_response.body:
Thank you very much for your honest feedback and for giving the game such a high rating!

My goal when creating Slice The Rhythm was to make something different from what already exists in the gaming industry, rather than simply copying existing rhythm games.

At the moment, the game doesn't have a traditional difficulty setting. Instead, the difficulty depends on the music track you choose. More energetic and dynamic songs spawn more enemies and create a greater challenge, while calmer tracks have fewer enemies and make the combat much easier.

Because of this, each song can be considered its own difficulty level and its own unique challenge. You might feel like an expert on one combat sequence, while on another you may feel like an average warrior. To achieve a high score, you need to find the rhythm of each individual song.

This approach gives every track its own unique combat rhythm, and the ability to add new songs means we can continuously create new combat experiences and fresh ways to slice through enemies.

Thank you again for taking the time to share your thoughts. Your feedback is greatly appreciated!
